name: Bauernschnapsen
summary: Austrian four-player partnership trick-taking game from Schnapsen, racing to 24 game points via bidding contracts.
rules_text: Four players in two fixed teams opposite each other use a 20-card Schnapsen deck: Ace, 10, King, Ober, Unter in four suits. Dealer deals three cards each, caller left of dealer chooses trump from those three or turns a card, then each gets two more to hold five. Caller may declare or pass; other players may bid higher contracts clockwise. If no bid, normal game: teams try for 66 card points, must follow suit and must win trick if possible, trump beats others. King+Ober of same suit announced scores 20, 40 if trump. Special bids Bettler (win no tricks), Schnapser (66 in 3 tricks), Gang (win all tricks, no trump), Bauernschnapser (win all with trump), Kontraschnapser etc score 4-12. First team to 24 points wins match.
